0 ║            The Classic Programmer's Greeting in Bricks             ║
0 ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
0 //
0 // VERSION: 1.0 (Beginner-Friendly Tutorial)
0 // SCENE TYPE: Introduction / Message Display
0 // PURPOSE: Learn LDraw fundamentals through RGB characters
0 //          presenting the traditional "Hello World" greeting
0 //
0 // WHAT YOU'LL LEARN:
0 //   ✓ RGB color system (Red=4, Green=2, Blue=1)
0 //   ✓ Minifigure assembly (HEAD → TORSO → ARMS → HIPS → LEGS)
0 //   ✓ Tile placement for messages
0 //   ✓ Spatial positioning (X/Y/Z coordinates)
0 //   ✓ LEGOS dramatic framework
0 //   ✓ Scene composition basics
0 //


0 ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
0 ║                    RGB COLOR SYSTEM                                ║
0 ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
0 //
0 // Primary Colors (Additive Light Model):
0 //   1 = BLUE   → Cool, calm, logic (Programmer archetype)
0 //   2 = GREEN  → Growth, harmony, balance (Designer archetype)
0 //   4 = RED    → Energy, passion, action (Hacker archetype)
0 //
0 // These three colors combine to create all others in screen displays.
0 // Our three characters represent the foundations of digital creation.
0 //


0 ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
0 ║                  COORDINATE SYSTEM REFERENCE                       ║
0 ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
0 //
0 //                    Y-AXIS (Vertical)
0 //                       ↑ negative (UP)
0 //                       |
0 //         X-AXIS ←------+------→ X-AXIS
0 //    negative (LEFT)    |    positive (RIGHT)
0 //                       |
0 //                       ↓ positive (DOWN)
0 //
0 //         Z-AXIS: negative (BACK) ← • → positive (FORWARD)
0 //
0 // UNITS: 20 LDU = 1 stud | 8 LDU = 1 plate | 24 LDU = 1 brick
0 //

0 ║                    LEGOS DRAMATIC FRAMEWORK                        ║
0 ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
0 //
0 // L (LOCATION): Digital void / Empty stage
0 //   • Minimal environment (focus on message)
0 //   • White baseplate (blank canvas metaphor)
0 //   • Open space for message display
0 //
0 // E (ENTITIES): Three RGB Characters
0 //   🔴 RED   → The Hacker (impulsive, breaks boundaries)
0 //   🟢 GREEN → The Designer (balanced, creates harmony)
0 //   🔵 BLUE  → The Programmer (logical, builds systems)
0 //
0 // G (GOAL): Communicate the universal greeting
0 //   → Share "Hello World" message with audience
0 //   → Demonstrate collaboration between archetypes
0 //   → Initiate connection with viewer
0 //
0 // O (OBSTACLE): Empty space / Lack of communication
0 //   → Silence before first program runs
0 //   → Need to establish shared language
0 //
0 // S (SHIFT): Message appears (tiles placed)
0 //   → Communication channel opens
0 //   → Universal greeting transcends barriers
0 //
0 // U (SOLUTION/UNIT): "HELLO WORLD" successfully displayed
0 //   → Three archetypes unite to create meaning
0 //   → Viewer receives traditional programmer's greeting
0 //   → Foundation for all future communication established
0 //
0 // PEDAGOGICAL PURPOSE:
0 //   Just as every programmer starts with "Hello World,"
0 //   every LDraw builder starts with three characters and a message.
0 //
